2607.08065.title: When LLMs Agree, Are They Right? Auditing Self-Consistency and Cross-Model Agreement as Confidence Signals
2607.08065.paper_summary: LLM-as-judge (Zheng et al., 2023) is increasingly the default for evaluating AI systems in enterprise pipelines, often scaled to ensembles (Verga et al., 2024) or "mixture-of-experts" (Shazeer et al., 2017) panels of judges. These systems share a key assumption: that consistency -- agreement among judges, or among a model's own samples -- indicates correctness. We show this assumption is unreliable. Agreement is not accuracy: a model can agree with itself, and different models can agree with each other, out of shared bias, a memorized heuristic, or an option-position prior rather than truth. We ask when agreement is nonetheless a usable proxy, in a large-scale cross-runner study: 53 runners drew K=50 samples for assigned overlapping cases across comparisons of model tier, prompting, and scale on GPQA Diamond and AIME -- 265,000 samples. Using majority-correctness as the deployment label and a hierarchical runner-clustered bootstrap, agreement is a positive but weak predictor (rho 0.20-0.59, all positive under item-clustered resampling) whose usefulness is regime-dependent: best for unsaturated mid-tier models and for allocating compute, and worst -- over-confident yet no more accurate -- for the most consistent frontier model (agreement >=0.8 on 77% of GPQA case-result entries, 48% of those wrong). An exploratory cross-family check on three Claude tiers shows the same frontier over-confidence, with confident errors recurring across providers above a marginal-preserving null. Self-consistency is thus a conditional proxy for correctness, not a standalone confidence score. We publicly release the de-identified per-run rows and answer distributions.
2607.08065.paper_summary_zh: LLM-as-judge (Zheng et al., 2023) 正逐漸成為企業管道中評估 AI 系統的默認選擇，通常擴展為集成 (Verga et al., 2024) 或 "專家混合" (Shazeer et al., 2017) 評審小組。這些系統共享一個關鍵假設：一致性——評審之間的協議，或模型自身樣本之間的協議——表示正確性。我們表明這一假設是不可靠的。協議並不等於準確性：一個模型可以與自己達成一致，而不同的模型也可以因共享偏見、記憶的啟發式或選項位置先驗而相互達成一致，而不是基於真相。我們在一項大規模的跨跑者研究中探討何時協議仍然是一個可用的代理：53 名跑者對指定的重疊案例進行了 K=50 的樣本抽取，這些案例橫跨模型層級、提示和 GPQA Diamond 及 AIME 的規模進行比較——共 265,000 個樣本。使用多數正確性作為部署標籤，並採用層次化跑者聚類自助法，協議是一個正面但弱的預測因子（rho 0.20-0.59，所有在項目聚類重抽樣下均為正），其有用性依賴於制度：對於未飽和的中層模型和計算分配最佳，而對於最一致的前沿模型則最差——過於自信但準確性並沒有提高（在 77% 的 GPQA 案例結果條目中協議 >=0.8，其中 48% 是錯誤的）。對三個 Claude 層級進行的探索性跨家族檢查顯示同樣的前沿過度自信，錯誤的自信在提供者之間重複出現，超過了邊際保留的零假設。因此，自我一致性是一個條件性正確性代理，而不是獨立的信心分數。我們公開釋放了去識別化的每次運行行和答案分佈。
2607.08065.author: Kaihua Ding et.al.
